ALDER PEAK ROBOTICS, INC.
2024 EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN

Section 8. Termination of Service. Following a termination of service, a participant may exercise vested options only within three months after the last day of service.
Section 9. Vesting. Unless an award agreement states otherwise, no portion of an option will vest until the participant has completed the one-year cliff period, and all unvested options are forfeited on termination.
Section 10. Repurchase. The Company may repurchase vested shares acquired on exercise upon a termination for cause at the lower of cost and fair market value.
Section 11. Transfer. Shares may not be transferred or sold without the prior written consent of the Board, and are subject to a right of first refusal in favor of the Company and a market stand-off during any initial public offering.
Section 12. A total of 6,000,000 shares are reserved for issuance under the Plan.
